steps.content: Your terminal vibrates. You answer it, and EMP's voice comes through, hot and bothered.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's me, Chief. Corso, that rotten thing, sh-sh-she's pulled one over on me, again!
EMP grumbles on. Only after a while do you straighten out what she's complaining about: Corso has gone AWOL again.

Earlier today, you assigned EMP to keep a close eye on Corso. During the mission, Corso went to the bathroom. But it's a ruse. She put her shoes on the bathroom floor to trick EMP and escaped through the vent. She hasn't been seen since.
You pacify EMP, who fell victim to Corso's deception and waited outside the bathroom stall for a long time. The phone call ends, and you hand the terminal to Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What do we do now, Chief?
I have an idea where she might be. I'll bring her back before she causes bigger troubles.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Do we need to get the guards and the FAC involved?
Ask them to stand by and wait for my message. The place I'm going is chaotic; if there are too many of us there, it might put them on alert. I'll make contact if I need help.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: All right. Be careful out there.

Guided by the shackles, you come to a topsy-turvy region of Syndicate where the signal linked to Corso is strongest. You turn into a well-concealed alley, and suddenly, it feels as though you have entered the lion's den.
The alley is teeming with hooligans, whose faces are glowing with excitement and whose hands are holding colorful pieces of paper.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Yo, you've got the ticket too.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: I sure do. A fighting contest in the old arena... Wouldn't miss it for the world.
The word arena rings a bell. Corso mentioned it during the interrogation. You creep closer, listening in on them.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: It was shut down after the Legion destroyed all the other gangs. Glad it's opening again. The fights were so damn exciting there.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Agreed. Those low-level fights are like catfights, boring as ****.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: I heard the host who bought the land has invited all the old fighters back.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Yeah, I'm here for Angus, the best fighter in the arena.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Hehe, I sure as hell want to watch Corso fight. She's not on the list, unfortunately.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Mad Dog? I didn't know you were into that kind of stuff.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Do you ever get a little tired of watching two big dudes throwing punches at each other?

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Better than watching Mad Dog, no doubt about it. A dirty player, she is. And in Syndicate, physical strength rules the day.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Seriously? You have no taste. Let me tell you: nothing is more exciting than an unexpected winning counterattack.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Unexpected counterattack? Sneak attack, more like. Without those little tricks, that tiny little thing wouldn't stand a chance of winning even one game.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Hold on a second, isn't there some unfinished business between them? Angus is back in the game. Where is Mad Dog?

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Too afraid to show her face, I'd say. Hahaha...
You had no idea Corso was so well-known. You're contemplating a way to approach the hooligans as you listen to their argument.
Hi, bros... I overheard you talking about the contest. You must be familiar with this area.
First time in the hood. Kind of lost. Would you mind telling me where the entrance is?
You try to recall how Hella and EMP talk, and mimic them while talking to the hooligans.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Lost?
They look at you with suspicion.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: You don't know the way? Never seen you before... Who are you?

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Hang on a second, this event is not open to the public. It's by invitation only. Who invited you?
My friend. We, um, got separated.
You look around, as if hoping to see your made-up friend. They press on.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Show us your ticket.
I don't have it with me. My friend is holding it for me.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: Are you a tiger or a pig?
Excuse me?

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: This is a cop all right.

steps.speaker: Hooligans A & B
steps.content: Hey, guys, we've got a pig here.
I am not...
Yo, what's going on here?
When the tension is about to boil over, a familiar voice cuts through the air. You feel a hand on your shoulder, and its owner quickly stands in front of you.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Cop? Where? I can't see any cop around here. My friend here, he's a bit on the timid side. Please don't scare him, okay?
steps.female_content: Cop? Where? I can't see any cop around here. My friend here, she's a bit on the timid side. Please don't scare her, okay?

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: M-mad Dog...

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: Mad... Corso, this person is with you?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Uh-huh. Do you have a problem with that?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You took care of my friend while I was not around.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: As a thank-you from him, I think I should take care of you now.
steps.female_content: As a thank-you from her, I think I should take care of you now.

steps.content: Corso brandishes her nail-studded wooden plank, and grins at the hooligans, exposing her pointed canine teeth.

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: It's just a misunderstanding, that's all. I was too stupid to see that your friend is one of us.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Okay, let's chalk that one up to a misunderstanding. But I also heard someone saying I'm afraid of Angus. That can't be a misunderstanding, can it?

steps.speaker: Hooligan B
steps.content: It's him. He said it.

steps.speaker: Hooligan A
steps.content: You ******* idiot! I... I didn't mean what I said earlier...

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Angus and I do have some unfinished business.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I'm here to take care of it. Now get lost!
Relieved to have escaped punishment, the hooligans run as fast as their legs can carry them.
The sorry sight elicits a snort from Corso. She then drapes her arm around your shoulders and steers you in the direction where the crowd is gathered.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I didn't expect to see you here, ${PlayerName}. You've come to watch the matches too?
Don't play dumb with me. You know why I'm here.
Not wanting to see a repeat of the cop incident, you decide not to shrug her arm off. You wear a smile and ask a question through gritted teeth.
Angus... that's the man you're looking for, right?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Exactly. Aren't you bright!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Let's go meet the man.

Her arm still draped around your shoulders, Corso guides you through the crowd. Presently, the two of you arrive at a guarded entrance. Upon realizing it's Corso, the guard steps aside and lets you come through.
On the other side of the entrance is a narrow flight of steps that leads underground. As you descend, your surroundings grow gloomier, and a sense of uneasiness sets in.
Finally, Corso stops in front of what looks like a wall at first glance. But it's not a wall, but a masterfully-camouflaged door.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: My friend, I present to you... the most exhilarating, electrifying form of traditional underground entertainment in all of Syndicate!
She gives you a mischievous grin. The moment the door opens, she gives you a gentle push, and you stumble inside.
All your senses come under assault. The blinding light, the deafening shrieks, the crowd's restlessness... they come at you all at once.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Welcome to the old underground arena, a fighter's paradise.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Nice place, huh?
I'd very much like to find out the M-values of these people.
You're knocked off balance by the hullabaloo. You wish to get away from the fanatics.

But that's not happening. Corso grabs your arm and, pulling you behind her, squeezes through the crowd. The two of you come to the front of the grandstand, where the light is the brightest and the noise the loudest.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: There's nothing to worry about. A fighting contest is supposed to be noisy and chaotic. Since you're already here, why don't you get into the spirit of things?
Standing at the rail beside Corso, you have a good view of the goings-on below.
You now understand why the crowd is being hysterical. The fight in the arena is reaching a crescendo.

<size=31>A man who is built like a tank knocks his opponent to the floor as if he's a sack of potatoes. The poor soul on the floor is struggling to stand up, but before he can do so, the giant puts a merciless foot on the back of his head; he gives up the struggle and lies still.</size>
The referee crouches down beside the motionless man. Having ascertained that he won't be able to get up, the referee stands up, grabs the giant's arm, and raises it high.
The spectators shriek with excitement, each of them a witness to the winner's moment of glory. The hysteria is so contagious that your heart starts pounding, and your blood pulsing.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: See that guy? That's Angus.
The winner, proud like a king bathed in glory, runs his eyes slowly over the crowd. But his face falls when Corso enters his line of sight.
Angus makes a thumbs-down gesture at Corso, and then runs his thumb over his throat while sticking out his tongue. Corso answers the provocative gesture by baring her teeth.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Didn't expect to see you here, Mad Dog. Come down here. Let's fight it out.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I wouldn't have noticed you if you weren't standing that high up. You know how tiny you are, right? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: It's been a while since I last saw you fight. Your fighting style hasn't changed a bit, still boring as hell.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Ah, not every fighter is like you, you cunning little thing.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Your dirty little tricks are nothing compared to absolute physical strength.
A sneer clings to her lips as Corso listens to Angus's provocative diatribe.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: My little tricks have helped me beat all the powerful fighters except you.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: That's because you're a ******* dirty fighter! Let me tell you something: Your little tricks might have worked on them, but they'll never work on me.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: As long as I'm here, you'll never become the No.1 fighter.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: That title only belongs to someone with absolute physical strength.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Bravo! And let me tell you something: I'm gonna defeat you today.
A crazed brightness has crept into Corso's eyes.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I'm gonna dethrone you and claim the throne for myself.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Then simple-minded brutes like you will kneel before me begging for mercy.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Come down here, and show me what you got.
The gauntlet has been thrown down, and it has been picked up.
The shackles vibrate strongly. You realize that Angus's scornful remarks are dried wood to the fire that's burning inside Corso.
There is no mistaking Corso's burning desire for victory, victory over her archenemy. Nothing will quench her raging fire until he's groveling at her feet.
With the fight pending, Corso turns around and leaves the grandstand without a backward glance. You follow her to a deserted corner.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You're not thinking about tying me up and carrying me back to the MBCC, are you?
No. You can have this fight.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Really? Why are you being so understanding all of a sudden? Carrot and stick, is this how the MBCC rolls? Is this some sort of charity?
This is not charity, and I'm not pitying you. It's just that I know some people were born to be great fighters. They all need a once-in-a-lifetime win to prove their worth to themselves.
And if someone takes that chance away from them, they will never trust this someone again.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahaha... Who knows, you might make a better "dog trainer" than me.
I have two conditions, though.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Fire away.
You must return to the MBCC with me after the fight, whatever the result. That's the first condition.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Will do.
The second one... I need to put a restraint on you through the shackles.
The restraint is You can't battle with anyone other than Angus. And it won't be lifted until you've turned to the MBCC with me.
You must agree to this condition if you want to fight Angus. You can't blame me for taking the precaution, considering you lied to me before.
Corso's face slightly contorts. Then slowly, she opens her arms, as if resigning herself to further control by you.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: It doesn't feel any different.
You can try...
Before you can finish the sentence, a rush of air comes at your face. Corso's blue-veined fist is inches away from your nose.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Well, looks like this shackles thing is working.
I didn't ask you to try it on me.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Don't get angry. When I get bitten by a dog while I'm training it, I never blame it; I blame myself for failing to keep it on a stronger leash.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you should be happy that your leash is working well, and you should pray that it will always work well, or...
Her voice trails off. She then gives an evil smile.
You let me worry about that. You should go get ready for the fight. And I hope you will win.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Ah, I will win, I definitely will.
